Maya - People Ops: Quick Q: Ravi wants to move Omar from SWE II (data infra) into a SWE III role on a new team AND increase base pay the same day. Is that allowed?
Ravi - Eng Manager: Team says Omar already owns SWE III scope. Budget constrained on new team. Can we grant effective date = transfer date if approvals aren't in before payroll?
Rewards Bot: Policy snippet: Transfers don't auto-change comp. Same-day promos allowed if approvals complete prior to payroll cutoff. If approvals occur after cutoff, changes apply next pay and retro pay is issued.
Omar - IC: I have an external offer deadline in 10 days. Can People Ops expedite review?
Maya - People Ops: Yes. Steps: 1) Submit "Comp Adjustment" form with justification + 2 peer calibrations + manager note. 2) Mark "Expedite - retention" and attach offer/last eval. Expedited reviews aim for 48-72 hrs but not guaranteed.
Ravi - Eng Manager: If the requested raise pushes Omar outside the level band, who signs off?
Maya - People Ops: Out-of-band or >20% requires Finance + Comp Chair. 10-20% requires Comp Chair review. In-band <=10% handled by People Ops with manager sign-off.
Omar - IC: If we request backdate to transfer monday, is there a limit on how far back?
Maya - People Ops: Backdates >30 days need additional audit justification and may be denied. We usually allow backdate to the transfer date if payroll timing aligns.
Ravi - Eng Manager: What if committee suggests a phased increase (partial now, rest in 6 months)? Can manager negotiate?
Maya - People Ops: Committee can recommend phased plans. Managers can propose alternative funding (e.g., spot bonus + later band adjustment). If you plan negotiation, document it in the packet so process is clear.
Rewards Bot: Helpful links: Comp Adjustment form: https://redwood.infra/hr/comp-adjust, Payroll cutoff calendar: https://redwood.infra/hr/payroll, Benchmark template: https://redwood.infra/templates/bench.csv
Maya - People Ops: TL;DR: stacking transfer+promo is possible. Submit full packet, flag expedite with evidence, expect 48-72 hrs for expedited review; >20% needs Finance. DM me the form link when submitted and I'll ping Comp Chair.
Ravi - Eng Manager: Thanks — filing now. Omar, I'll attach your offer and ping Maya. :thumbsup:
